snippet.title: Critical Ward - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Critical Ward is a fast-paced arcade survivors-like where, instead of killing the horde, you have to save it.

Treat endless waves of patients, build huge combos, deploy medical equipment and survive escalating hospital chaos before saturation reaches 100%.

A free demo is available now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4879410/

You can also play Critical Ward demo directly in your browser:
https://biesel-games.itch.io/critical-ward-demo

Critical Ward launches on November 3, 2026.
Wishlist now and try the demo!

#CriticalWard #IndieGame #Roguelite #SurvivorsLike #PixelArt
